retiredCustomPriceFeeds.$comment: Deployed feed contracts no longer configured as NAV price sources. A SIBLING of customPriceFeeds, not a member of it, and that is the whole point: reset_deployment_records.CLEAR_SECTIONS is ["balanceAdapters", "customPriceFeeds"] and its loop blanks EVERY non-empty value in a listed section, so a retirement note stored inside customPriceFeeds is destroyed by the very step-1.1 reset that makes the record worth annotating. Measured, not assumed: both the address and the note come back as "". This section is in neither CLEAR_TOP nor CLEAR_SECTIONS, so plan_for never touches it.
retiredCustomPriceFeeds.$OETH: RETIRED 2026-08-12. The contract IS still deployed at the address above and this record is kept deliberately: deployments/<id>.json is the ONLY place addresses live, so deleting it would leave the repo unable to recognise its own address in a trace or an old NAV read. What was removed is INTENT, not reality: OETH is gone from nav-config/assets-and-price-feeds/1.json and from contracts-deployment-config/custom-price-feeds/1.json, because Chainlink is sunsetting the OETH/ETH rate feed 0x703118C4CbccCBF2AB31913e0f8075fbbb15f563 that this CrossRate feed consumes. We hold no OETH, so this is a planned retirement and NOT an incident. HISTORICAL: it was still registered on the PREVIOUS-GENERATION NAV — measured 2026-08-12, getRegisteredAssets() on the now-SUPERSEDED proxy 0x80eD5cc6cEbAe4fEE1eD8687279aa492A50afa8d returned 43 assets including OETH 0x856c4Efb76C1D1AE02e20CEB03A2A6a08b0b8dC3, so at that point the change was config intent and not an on-chain deregistration. RESOLVED BY THE 2026-08-18 REDEPLOY: re-measured 2026-08-19 on the CURRENT proxy 0x54EaD2A1dB7456cA917675Ea8908ec8A997c6214 — 43 assets, OETH ABSENT (the count is unchanged only because wARS was added in the same wave). The superseded proxy still answers with 43 INCLUDING OETH; that is the abandoned stack, not the live one. THE REDEPLOY HAPPENED 2026-08-18 and behaved as predicted: 03 is config-gated so it did not redeploy this feed, and RegisterAssets never registered the asset. Moving it out of customPriceFeeds also moves it out of verify_step's step-1.5 NAV-pointer check and out of bytecode_audit's customPriceFeeds.* scan, so the STALE_NAV report the earlier note predicted no longer fires — deliberate, because a permanently-red gate on a deliberately-retired feed is the kind of noise operators learn to step around. The previous-generation-feed guard is NOT weakened: verify_step.previous_generation_feeds unions the archive with snapshots/pre/<chainId>.json, and this feed is present there as a Custom feed, so it is still recognised as old-generation.
